description: This file defines a mock class 'MediaPipelineServerInternalFactoryMock' for unit testing, which implements the 'IMediaPipelineServerInternalFactory' interface. It provides mock methods to create media pipeline objects and internal server objects, used in testing media pipeline components within the Rialto server project.

classes.name: MediaPipelineServerInternalFactoryMock
classes.description: A mock class implementing IMediaPipelineServerInternalFactory for testing purposes, providing mocked methods to create media pipeline objects and internal server objects.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Mock method to create a media pipeline, taking a weak pointer to a client and video requirements, returning a unique pointer to IMediaPipeline.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineServerInternal
methods.description: Mock method to create a media pipeline server internal object, taking client weak pointer, video requirements, session ID, shared memory buffer, and decryption service, returning a unique pointer to IMediaPipelineServerInternal.
